items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos o primeiro Tatu Open Curitiba!
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8).

É muito importante que você conheça o regulamento, que pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

Inscrições na hora do evento serão aceitas somente para a modalidade 3x3x3

É importante chegar pelo menos meia hora antes das categorias que for participar para relizar o check in. Lembrando que se for sua primeira competição, você irá precisar levar um documento com foto.

**English**
It is with great joy that we announce the first Tatu Open Curitiba!
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner (first competition)', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Registrations during the competition will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event.

It is important to arrive half an hour before the events you'll participate in to do the check-in. Also remember that if this is your first competition, you'll need to bring a photo ID.

items.information:
## Português

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.
* Alunos e funcionários da FECAP estão isentos da taxa de inscrição

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 170 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

**Esta competição tem um limite de inscrições, portanto, caso tenha se inscrito e não possa mais participar, favor informar à equipe de organização, para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outro competidor.**

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.
* Students and employees of FECAP will be waived from the registration fee.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 170 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

**This competition has a competitor limit, so if you have registered and will no longer be able to attend, please inform the organization team, so the spot can be given to another competitor.**

![Image description](https://i.postimg.cc/C1vLjXXn/logo-fecap.png)

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information:
## [FR]

### Série Saint-Augustin 2025

Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! 

Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents.

Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***.


### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

## [EN]

### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series

One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! 

You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets.

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***


### Registration Reminders

You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: North Carolina Championship 2025

venue.name: UNC Charlotte Popp Martin Student Union

items.information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthCarolinaChampionship2025#53802-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Minors are required to be accompanied by an adult per University policy.**

Competition apparel is only available by **pre-order**. You must pre-order by the deadline to have competition apparel.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Nzg2NTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--74c85f437554d9209215d46e43ebc3735a2d0544/1%20(1).jpg)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTIwNjksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--448cc0ae75bf0e0f72a530e10f4a8ac539ed36eb/Cave%20Springs%20Resize.jpg)
- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingInCaveSprings2025#57658-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingInCaveSprings2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.***   

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

items.name: Belmont Spring 2025
items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! 
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a few days before the competition date for relevant info.
